sentences.text: Researchers developed a nasal spray using lipid nanoparticles to deliver genetic instructions for a brain-supporting protein, testing the approach on older mice and mice with a genetic form of Alzheimer's disease.
This delivery method addresses the challenge that the body's natural barrier usually blocks these types of drugs from reaching the brain.
Mice that received the nasal spray showed better memory performance than those that did not.
The authors suggest this method could be a useful way to treat brain disorders linked to aging.
